thread_title: S. flava Bulloch Co, GA (recently extirpated site)
breadcrumb: S. flava Bulloch Co, GA (recently extirpated site)

posts.body_html:
Despite being over crowded and not transplanting these forever, they're still doing pretty well! I think they'll get divided this coming winter. Pics taken 6/22/21:




I've done a seed increase on this population as a backup. That said, these seeds wouldn't be used for reintroductions because I did find a few flowers pollinated by native insects, which means the seeds I made could easily have some cross contamination. It'll be somewhat easy to tell when you grow them out, unless nearby flavas were mixed in. Even that, if I see a seedling that's growing with hybrid vigor while the rest are growing slowly, then it would be easy to get rid of the unwanted open pollinated individuals:
